english: …Please don't step on the gun parts.
Huh…?\nSorry sorry sorry.\nI didn't even notice your presence, Reki-san.
I've been here the whole time.
(Do all snipers have no presence like this…?)
…Something?
Ah, no, nothing.
…Then please give me back\nthe part you're stepping on.\nI can't get on with my work.
Ah, sorry…
Thank you.
Gun maintenance?
Yes.
(The conversation isn't going anywhere…)
Um, you always wear those headphones.
They're bulletproof headphones.
Bulletproof…? Um, do you like music?
No. I'm listening to 'the voice of the wind.'
(The voice of the wind?\nBetween that and 'bulletproof headphones,'\nI don't understand a word she's saying.)
…By the way, do you need something?
Ah, no, nothing…
I see.\nThen could you move away?\nThere are parts lying around here.
Ah, yes. Excuse me.
I was going to offer to help, but…
I'll take just the thought.\nMaintaining this gun is very specialized.
Besides, it needs constant fine-tuning\njust for me, so other hands would\nonly get in the way.
R-right…
(Looks like I got in her way…)
(Whether it's just Reki-san or snipers in general,\nshe's got a strange air about her…)
Nobody's going to take it, so relax\nand eat slowly.
Reki-san. Is something wrong?
I was feeding this little one.
This little one?
Squeak squeak!
It's not a dog, and not a cat…\nWhat kind of creature is it?
I don't know either.\nIt's a creature I've never seen.
At least, in the world I came from,\nno such creature existed.
Either it always lived around here,\nor it got dragged into this world.
*cough* *cough*…
No good, it seems to have choked.\nDo you have water?
Ah, yes!
…*cough*! Squeak squeak!
Good. …Thank you.
Don't mention it.
There, there. There are no enemies here.\nEat more slowly.
…Are you going to keep it?
No. It seems to be a wild creature.
(She looks a little disappointed, I think…)
But it still looks like a baby.\nIts parent doesn't seem to be around, either—\nwe can't just leave it…
While we're moving around,\nwe might find its parent.
…It can't be helped. I'll take it in\nuntil we find its parent.
Shake.
Squeak!
(This time she looks happy, I think.\nShe really does love animals…)
Well then, excuse me.
Huh?
Even taking this little one in, I can't just\ndecide on my own, so I'm going to\nconsult everyone.
I'll come with you.\nSince I happened to be here and all.
Really. Thank you.\nThen, shall we go.
Good luck. Everyone's kind,\nso I'm sure they'll understand.
Yes, thank you.\nWell then, I'm off.
(Reki-san seems to like animals.\nShe's usually expressionless, but when animals\nare involved, her face changes just a little… I think.)
You brought food for this little one.\nThank you, as always.
Squeak squeak!
What were you doing, Reki-san?
Making cartridges.
Cartridges?
Live rounds… roughly speaking, bullets.\nStore-bought ones vary in performance.
Even a tiny difference in gunpowder\nshifts the impact point a lot when sniping.\nSo I prepare my own.
(I don't understand any of this…)
…That was a hard-to-follow explanation.\nSorry.
Ah, no…
Sounds like a lot of work.
No, I always do it.\nAll snipers do.
(I see… I guess they're all\nthe quiet type?)
Squeak squeak!
Looks like it's done eating.\nHey, you can't chew on bullets!\nThose aren't snacks!
Stop that…!
Squeak!
If they go off, you'll get hurt.\nAnd the bullet material is toxic to the body.
Squeak…
(It's all droopy after being scolded.\nMaybe it understands words.)
Could you hold this little one?\nIt's dangerous while I'm working.
Ah, yes.\nNow, be good…
Thank you.
No more getting in the way.
Squeak…
(It quieted down when Reki-san told it to.\nThis little one seems to understand\nwhat we say.)
(Or is Reki-san the special one?\n…She's a strange person, so I can't say\nit's impossible…)
(What is that little one doing?\nWandering around a little ways away from Reki-san…)
…Gun maintenance again?
Yes. It's almost time for an\noverhaul…
(She looks kind of lonely, or maybe\nsad…)
Are you maybe lonely?
No. There are tiny parts here,\nso being pounced on would be\na little troublesome.
(Is she forcing it, or is that genuine…)
The maintenance is coming along.
…Yes. It's an overhaul, so I'm taking it\napart down to the small parts—\nthis is actually more convenient.
How much longer until it's done?
Just the reassembly left, so\nalmost done.\n…Do you need something?
Ah, no, nothing in particular.
I see.
(The tiny parts are becoming a gun at incredible speed…\nIt's like a little bit of magic…!)
Done.
It's done, you know?
(As always, it won't go near Reki-san.)
What's wrong?
Maybe it thinks you're\nstill mad at it…?
I see. Understood.
I'm not angry anymore.\nAnd the overhaul is done, too.
Squeak!
There, there.
It was holding back too.\nIt was so happy it pounced.
…From now on, don't get in the way.\nThen I won't get angry.
Squeak!
(Reki-san looks happy too… I think.)
I'm glad, Reki-san!
Yes, thank you.
You brought food again.\nThank you, as always.
Squeak!
This is late in the game, but… was dog food\nreally okay for it?
Dry food is the most nutritionally stable.\nI use it myself, too.
D-dog food?!
No. Human solid field rations.\nThe only downside is they have\nalmost no moisture.
…So what you gave it the other day\nwas those rations?
Yes. I told it to eat slowly, but it seemed\nhungry and choked.
Thank you for back then.
N-no problem!
Hm? Is someone there?
Grrr…!
…! Get behind me.
Th-this animal…!\nCould it be this little one's parent…?
Grauw…!
Looks that way.
B-but it looks really mad!
I think it sees us as the enemies\nwho kidnapped its child.
Then if we give the little one back…!
Grrrrrr…!
Its blood is up. Left alone, this will\nend in the worst possible way.\n…It can't be helped.
Huh?
Guh!
D-don't tell me you killed it?!
No. I grazed a bullet across the upper part between\nits spinal and thoracic vertebrae,\ncompressing it for an instant.
It won't be able to move below the neck for a while.\nLet's return this little one in the meantime.
Squeeee!
Gauw…!
We were only looking after this little one.\nTake it home and cherish it.
Gauw…
…It seems to understand.
Good, for a moment I didn't know\nhow that would end…
…A parent-child reunion with one of them flat on\nthe ground isn't right, is it… Heal!
Gauw gauw!
You're kind.
You too, Reki-san. You used that method\nbecause you didn't want to hurt it, right?
(Is she embarrassed… I wonder?)
So this is goodbye for this little one.
…Yes.
I'm glad we found its parent!
Yes. I have to report to everyone else, too.
Squeak!
Gauw!
Don't get separated again.
(The strange animal parent and child walked off.\nIs it just my imagination that Reki-san\nlooks a little lonely?)
Reki-san? You're looking around—\nis something wrong?
Were you maybe looking for me?
No, I wasn't.
Just kidding. The parent and child?
Yes. I'm a little worried whether they\nmade it back to their nest safely.
Were you looking for that parent and child\nfrom the other day?
Yes. I'm a little worried whether they\nmade it back to their nest safely.
I was thinking the same thing.\nBut I'm sure they're fine.
I hope so…
I'm sure they're getting along.\nThey finally got reunited, after all.
And that's thanks to you, Reki-san,\nso don't look so down.
Yes.
…If you found that parent and child,\nwhat would you do?
I don't plan to do anything in particular.\nIf they're safe, that's enough.
But that little one took to you, Reki-san—\nit might follow you, right?
I can't say it wouldn't.
Then tell me if it happens.\nI'll help again.
…Thank you.
Well then, excuse me.
(Even as she says that, her eyes keep\ndarting around… She really is lonely…)
…Perfect timing.\nI was looking for you.
For me? What's wrong, all of a sudden?
…I wanted to thank you.
Thank me?
Yes.
Come on, you're joking…
I'm not joking.
I don't recall doing anything…
Did you forget?\nIt was the other day.
Thank you very much.
(Wh-what, a smile?! I think that's the\nfirst time I've ever seen one…)
(C-could it be about me cheering up\nthe downcast-looking Reki-san…?)
D-don't worry about it!\nI didn't do anything special!
No, it helped a lot.\nPlease help me again when I'm in trouble.
Y-yes! Leave it to me!
Well then, excuse me.
Huh, a smile? That Reki-san smiled at me?\nI've never even seen her expression change,\nlet alone smile…
Could it be she… likes me?
Huh? Where on earth is this?\nLooks like a school, but I don't recognize it…
…Come this way.
Reki-san? You're in this classroom?
Welcome.
R-Reki-san?! That outfit…!\nA lab coat and glasses…?
I prepared it for you.\n…Does it suit me?
(An upward glance through the glasses…!)
I-it really does…!\nWh-what is this place, anyway?!
The cosplay café, SHC.\nI prepared this shop for you, too.
F-for me?!
Yes. This cake, this tea, and myself—all of it.
Y-your face is close!
Mmm…
W-what, they licked my face…!
Squeak!
Gauw!
What's wrong?
Whoa! Why are you guys here?!
Squeak!
Gauw!
It seems the world these little ones came from\nis somewhere else. I've decided to take them\nalong until we get there.
Luckily, they've taken to us, and they seem\nobedient, so I don't think they'll be\nmuch trouble.
I-I see… By the way, why is my face\nall sticky?
They found you asleep and were happily\nlicking your face.
A-all of it was a dream…?
Sorry for waking you.\nI told them to stop, but…
So that smile the other day—\nwas that because these little ones had come?
…Did I not say?
You didn't tell me…
